juno_devx: Noticing a regression: our async client loses the tracing/request-id when retries/backoff run. Repro below, tiny.

juno_devx: ```py
# repro (asyncio + redwood async client)
from contextvars import ContextVar
from redwood import AsyncClient
req_id = ContextVar('req_id')
async def main():
    req_id.set('r-42')
    client = AsyncClient(retry_policy={'max_attempts':2})
    await client.generate_async('hello')  # inner logs for attempt 2 have empty req_id
```

eli_sdk: Thanks. This smells like contextvars not being copied when we spawn backoff timers / tasks. We saw similar when adding token refresh.

feroze_infra: Quick question: does this only happen with the otel instrumentor enabled, or even with simple structlog-bound context?

juno_devx: Repro shows it with both, but more reliably when the otel instrumentor is active. With just structlog binding it sometimes holds.

ada_obs: Proposal: add a small, typed observability callback API on the client so apps can rebind context when events occur (emit_log, span_start, retry). Something like:
```
client.register_observer('emit_log', fn)
```
where fn can be sync or async.

eli_sdk: I prefer a Protocol for typing:
```
class ObsCallback(Protocol):
    def __call__(self, event: str, attrs: Mapping[str,str]) -> Optional[Awaitable[None]]: ...
```
Client will call each registered callback and await if it returns an awaitable. That keeps parity for sync and async hooks.

feroze_infra: Long-term fix: centralise task spawn so we always use context.copy_context().run(...) for background tasks (backoff timers, batcher, token refresh). Short-term: hooks give an escape hatch.

juno_devx: I'll add a tiny sample-app test that forces a transient error to trigger retry and asserts both logs and traces include req_id. Put it under devex/sample-apps/tests.

eli_sdk: Action items: 1) add ObsCallback Protocol + register_observer API, 2) audit/spawn helper to preserve context, 3) convenience adapters: bind_contextvar(name, var) and instrument_opentelemetry(), 4) integration test and small doc note about contextvar caveats. I'll open a draft PR with the helper first (minimal surface).

ci-bot: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py/pull/501 (draft) — CI queued.

juno_devx: Thanks all. I'll paste failing log snippets and the mini-repro into the PR description.
